summary: auth set-token / logout with an explicit --config now write and remove that config's sibling credential store instead of the global one. credentialSavePath now reports the store actually written via Config.CredentialStorePath().
reason: Greptile P1 on publish PR #1668: loads preferred the explicit config's sibling credentials but mutations always hit the global store — set could be silently ineffective and logout could delete an unrelated credential.
validated_outcome: Explicit-config mutations round-trip through CredentialsFilePathForConfig; default path behavior unchanged; build/tests pass.
